checked_ok.claim: expo-camera (57.0.6, SDK 57) uses Google's ML Kit on Android, the bundled model com.google.mlkit:barcode-scanning:17.3.0 (statically linked, so it also works on phones without Google services).
Bundled ML Kit barcode model adds about 2.4 MB (unbundled about 200 KB).
Android analysis frames use ResolutionStrategy.HIGHEST_AVAILABLE_STRATEGY, i.e. highest available resolution; there is no prop to change it.
zoom prop is a 0 to 1 fraction of the device max zoom; expo-camera exposes no real zoom factor and no max zoom value to JS.
Default wide lens, no 0.5x: iOS opens AVCaptureDevice.default(.builtInWideAngleCamera) (selectedLens is iOS only, default builtInWideAngleCamera); Android clamps the zoom ratio to at least 1.
Live-camera-only scanning is the default; decoding an image needs the separate scanFromURLAsync call, which the app simply never calls.

A signature makes the QR bigger: Ed25519 signature is 64 bytes (R 32 + S 32), which forces about version 4-L (78 bytes), while a MAC payload fits version 2-L (32 bytes); about 24 percent bigger modules on the same screen.
Low error correction suits a clean display; raising the level enlarges the code (Denso Wave: Level L for clean environment).
Accepting the current and the previous code matches RFC 6238 (at most one time step for delay).
ble-plx Expo plugin breaks on SDK 56: issue #1339 opened 2026-06-01, still open, affects 3.5.1; last ble-plx release 3.5.1 on 2026-02-18 (previous 3.5.0 on 2025-02-11).
react-native-ble-manager is current (12.5.3, 2026-09-21), new architecture only, and its Expo plugin imports from expo/config-plugins, so it does not hit the SDK 56 import problem.
munim-bluetooth is new and single-maintainer: first publish 2025-11-12, 0.9.0 on 2026-10-03, one npm maintainer, 24 GitHub stars.

iPhone advertising: only local name and service UUIDs, 28 bytes in foreground (plus 10 bytes scan response for the name); in background the name is dropped and UUIDs go to an overflow area only iOS scanners looking for them can see.
iBeacon on iPhone goes through Core Location and needs location authorization.

Android 12+: BLUETOOTH_SCAN and BLUETOOTH_ADVERTISE, with neverForLocation no location permission; Android 11 and lower need ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION. neverForLocation also filters some beacons, one more reason to avoid beacon formats.
Location services off stops Bluetooth scanning, except Android 12+ apps that declare neverForLocation.
Phone GPS degrades near and inside buildings (4.9 m open sky, worse near buildings; Android precise location usually within about 50 m).
Another product leaked the session location and it was replayed with fake coordinates (iClicker PoC).
Android mock flag: Location.isMock added in API 31, isFromMockProvider deprecated there.
iOS isSimulatedBySoftware marks on-device software simulation (Xcode GPX); a third-party spoofer (iToolab AnyTo) was reported as never flagged and Apple could not promise coverage.
expo-location (SDK 57) gives `mocked` on Android only and no iOS source information, so the iPhone flag needs own native code.
Emulators fail Play Integrity device integrity (MEETS_DEVICE_INTEGRITY needs a genuine certified device).

findings.finding: The 10 s / 30 s delay thresholds ignore the plan's own clock allowance (line 188: 2 s + 100 ppm of elapsed time, certificate up to 7 days). With a 1-day-old time certificate the allowance is already about 10.6 s, 3 days about 27.9 s, 7 days about 62.5 s. A legitimate scan can therefore look 10 to 30 s late (flagged, more instructor review) or over 30 s late (rejected), which hits the 'Haksız devamsız 0' target. Same rule repeated at line 291.

evidence.quote: Because of possible clock drifts between a client and a validation server, we RECOMMEND that the validator be set with a specific limit to the number of time steps a prover can be "out of synch" before being rejected.

findings.recommendation_tr: QR gecikmesini hesaplarken iki telefonun saat payını düşerim (2 saniye + geçen sürenin milyonda 100'ü). Saat belgesi eski olduğu için payı 10 saniyeyi aşan kayıtta gecikme yalnız işaretlenir; ret için pay düşüldükten sonra kalan farkın 30 saniyeyi aşması gerekir. 291. satırdaki kural da buna göre yazılır.

findings.plan_quote: Hocanın telefonunun saati yanlışsa ders işaretlenir.
findings.finding: Line 251 makes the QR time slot a time proof for students, so the instructor phone must not take the slot from its wall clock, which the user or network can move. The app already has the signed time certificate plus monotonic counter (lines 182 to 190); using it on the instructor phone makes a wrong phone clock harmless instead of flagging the whole class.

evidence.quote: The wall clock can be set by the user or the phone network (see setCurrentTimeMillis(long)), so the time may jump backwards or forwards unpredictably.

findings.recommendation_tr: Hoca telefonu QR'ın zaman dilimini kendi saatinden değil, öğrenci telefonu gibi saat belgesi ve iç sayaçtan hesaplar. Telefonun saati yalnız not düşülür; geçerli saat belgesi yoksa QR yine üretilir ama ders işaretlenir.

findings.plan_quote: QR'da dijital imza değil kısa bir doğrulama kodu (MAC) kullanılır
findings.finding: The plan does not say how the MAC payload is written into the QR. expo-camera returns only a string (`data`), and iOS returns nil when the payload cannot be turned into a string, so raw binary is unsafe; base64 needs byte mode and pushes a 25-byte payload to version 3. Writing the payload as digits (numeric mode) keeps it in version 2-L (77 digits): 1 version byte + 4 key/session + 4 slot + 16-byte (128-bit) MAC is about 61 digits; an 80-bit MAC (RFC 2104 minimum) is about 46 digits.

evidence.quote: The parsed information encoded in the barcode.
The value of this property is an NSString created by decoding the binary payload according to the format of the machine-readable code, or nil if a string representation cannot be created.
the output length t be not less than half the length of the hash output (to match the birthday attack bound) and not less than 80 bits
Version 2, Level L: Numeric 77, Alphanumeric 47, Byte 32 (table row, secondary corroboration of ISO/IEC 18004)

findings.recommendation_tr: QR'a yalnız rakam yazarım (sayısal kip); ikili veri ya da base64 yazmam. İçerik en çok 77 rakam olur, böylece QR sürüm 2'de ve L düzeyinde kalır. MAC en az 80 bit olur; 128 bit bile yaklaşık 61 rakamla sığar. Sebep: expo-camera sonucu yalnız metin olarak veriyor, iPhone da metne çevrilemeyen içerikte boş değer döndürüyor.

findings.plan_quote: kareleri en yüksek çözünürlükte işler; düşük modelli telefonlarda denenir
findings.finding: The fact is right, but Google advises the opposite for ML Kit: native-resolution frames give very poor latency with no accuracy gain, about 2 MP (1280x720 or 1920x1080) is enough and still reads from a distance. expo-camera hard-codes HIGHEST_AVAILABLE for analysis and offers no prop; CameraX then picks the real size per device hardware level with Preview and ImageCapture also bound, so slow reads can appear on mid and high-resolution phones too, not only low-end ones. Alternatives are heavier: VisionCamera 5 needs four packages (camera, barcode-scanner, nitro-modules, nitro-image) and ships ML Kit on iOS too; an own CameraX plus zxing-cpp module means writing the preview view and analyzer. expo-camera stays the most compact choice.

evidence.quote: On some devices, capturing input at the native resolution produces extremely large (10+ megapixels) images, which results in very poor latency with no benefit to accuracy. Instead, only request the size from the camera that's required for barcode detection, which is usually no more than 2 megapixels.
.setResolutionStrategy(ResolutionStrategy.HIGHEST_AVAILABLE_STRATEGY)
CameraX determines resolutions based on the set of use cases bound by considering the device's supported hardware level and by accounting for device-specific variance
MLKit on both platforms, so formats and accuracy stay aligned.
Prepare a package for patching (inspired by a similar command in Yarn).

findings.recommendation_tr: expo-camera'da kalırım; VisionCamera 4 paket getiriyor, kendi kamera modülüm önizlemeyi baştan yazmak demek. En arka sıra denemesinde desteklenen en ucuz Android'de ve yüksek çözünürlüklü bir Android'de ilk okuma süresini ölçerim. Yavaş çıkarsa yeni paket eklemem; expo-camera'nın analiz çözünürlüğünü pnpm patch ile 1920x1080'e sabitlerim.

findings.plan_quote: 2x değeri telefonun en büyük yakınlaştırmasından yerel modülde hesaplanır
findings.finding: expo-camera maps `zoom` differently per platform, and only in source code: Android ratio = zoom x maxZoomRatio (clamped to at least 1), iOS factor = videoMaxZoomFactor ^ zoom. One shared formula gives the wrong zoom on one platform (for example a linear 2/16 on an iPhone with max 16 gives about 1.41x, not 2x). iOS max depends on the active format, so it must be read after the camera starts. These internals can change in any SDK upgrade.

evidence.quote: val targetZoomRatio = max(1f, min(maxZoomRatio, value.coerceIn(0f, 1f) * maxZoomRatio))
device.videoZoomFactor = minZoom * pow(device.activeFormat.videoMaxZoomFactor / minZoom, delegate.zoom)

findings.recommendation_tr: 2x için zoom değerini platforma göre hesaplarım: Android'de 2 / en büyük oran, iPhone'da log(2) / log(en büyük çarpan). En büyük değeri kamera açıldıktan sonra okurum. Bu iki formül expo-camera'nın iç kodundan geldiği için her SDK yükseltmesinde 2x'i gerçek telefonda denerim.

findings.finding: expo-camera also offers launchScanner, which is live camera too but on Android hands scanning to Google Play services: it cannot run on phones without Google services (accepted by line 78) and takes lens and zoom control away. The plan should name the CameraView path explicitly.

evidence.quote: On Android, we will use the Google code scanner
This is accomplished by delegating the task of scanning the code to Google Play services and returning only the scan results to your app.

findings.recommendation_tr: QR'ı yalnız expo-camera'nın kamera görünümüyle okuturum; hazır tarama ekranı (launchScanner) kullanılmaz. Android'de bu ekran taramayı Google Play hizmetlerine bırakıyor: Google servisi olmayan telefonda çalışmaz, lens ve yakınlaştırma da benim elimde olmaz.

findings.plan_quote: Yayın için kendi yerel modülüm ya da sürümü sabitlenmiş munim-bluetooth (yeni ve tek geliştiricili)
findings.finding: No sustainable advertising library exists: munim-bluetooth has 52 pre-1.0 releases in 11 months (13 on one day), one maintainer, and pulls react-native-nitro-modules; older ones are dead (react-native-ble-advertiser 0.0.17 in 2022-09, react-native-peripheral 0.0.3 in 2022-05). So the own module will hold advertising anyway, and iPhone advertising is only two keys. Scan-only (no connect, no GATT) is one more call per platform in the same module, which removes react-native-ble-manager, its config plugin and its extra permissions (it adds BLUETOOTH_CONNECT and location permissions). Library manifest permissions merge into the app, so no config plugin is needed. Trade-off: about a few hundred lines of own native code instead of two dependencies.

evidence.quote: "created": "2025-11-12T16:08:39.067Z", "0.9.0": "2026-10-03T07:58:23.101Z", "maintainers": ["sheehanmunim"], "peerDependencies": {"react-native-nitro-modules": ">=0.36.5 <1"}
The peripheral manager only supports two keys: CBAdvertisementDataLocalNameKey and CBAdvertisementDataServiceUUIDsKey.
Manifest file from an included library - If you have multiple libraries, their manifest priorities match the order they appear in your Gradle dependencies block.

findings.recommendation_tr: Bluetooth'un tamamını kendi yerel modülüme koyarım: hoca telefonunda yayın, öğrenci telefonunda yalnız tarama, bağlantı kurulmaz. react-native-ble-manager ve munim-bluetooth plandan çıkar. İzinleri modülün Android dosyasına ve app.json'a yazarım; yapılandırma eklentisi gerekmez.

findings.plan_quote: dakikalık bir pencerede tarar ve sinyal gücünü kaydeder
findings.finding: Scanning for 2 to 3 minutes on each student phone goes against Android guidance (stop as soon as found, always time-limit). A phone in range sees the advertiser within seconds. Android also silently drops results after more than 5 scan starts in 30 s (secondary source) and pauses unfiltered scans when the screen turns off. A fixed first half of the 128-bit service UUID lets Android filter with a UUID mask; the rotating code sits in the second half, which also fits iPhone's service-UUID-only advertising. The 2-minute figure matches Acadly, whose design differs (see S10-F09).

evidence.quote: As soon as you find the desired device, stop scanning. Never scan on a loop, and always set a time limit on your scan.
Set filter on partial service uuid. The uuidMask is the bit mask for the serviceUuid.
Stop unfiltered BLE scanning on screen off
call startScan() more than five times in a 30-second window, and the system quietly stops delivering results.

findings.recommendation_tr: Hoca 2-3 dakika yayın yapar, ama öğrenci telefonu güncel kodu birkaç kez görünce taramayı bitirir, en çok 30 saniye tarar. Android'de tek tarama oturumu açarım ve servis kimliğinin sabit ilk yarısına göre süzerim; kod ikinci yarıdadır ve QR ile aynı anahtardan üretilir. 30 saniyede 5'ten fazla tarama başlatılmaz.

findings.finding: The 2 to 5 percent miss expectation (and the 5 percent target at line 851) comes from Acadly, which detects students through a mesh of student phones over Bluetooth and WiFi and quotes more than 95 percent, about 98 percent after training. The plan's design is single-hop (instructor phone to each student phone), so in a large hall the miss rate is unknown and may be higher. QR-verified records give a free ground truth to measure it.

evidence.quote: Acadly discovers students in the professors' proximity using a mesh-network technology that uses Bluetooth and WiFi.
If everyone has the app installed, on average, more than 95% of all students present in a class should be marked present.

findings.recommendation_tr: %2-5'i beklenti olarak değil, denenecek hedef olarak yazarım; bu sayı öğrenci telefonları arasında aktarmalı (mesh) çalışan Acadly'den geliyor, benim yöntemim tek adımlı. İlk denemede en büyük amfide ölçerim: QR ile doğrulanmış kayıtlar içinde Bluetooth kodunu görmeyenlerin oranı, telefon modeline göre ayrı. 851. satırdaki %5 hedefi bu ölçümle kontrol edilir.

findings.finding: Android 12+ users can grant only approximate location (about 3 square km) whatever the app declares, and iOS 14+ users can switch off Precise Location (expo-location reports accuracy 'reduced'). Then the 'near the building' check is meaningless and must not count against the student. iOS can ask for temporary full accuracy at check-in time, but expo-location does not expose that call.

evidence.quote: If the user grants the approximate location permission, your app only has access to approximate location, regardless of which location permissions your app declares.
this estimate is accurate to within about 3 square kilometers (about 1.2 square miles)
Requests permission to temporarily use location services with full accuracy and reports the results to the provided completion handler.

findings.recommendation_tr: Konumu yalnız kesin konum izniyle kullanırım. Öğrenci yalnız yaklaşık konum verirse GPS kontrolü yapılmaz ve kayıt 'konum yok' sayılır; bu ret ya da işaret sebebi değildir. iPhone'da yoklama anında geçici kesin konum izni kendi modülümden istenir.

findings.plan_quote: expo-location; Android'de sahte konum işareti hazır geliyor, iPhone'un işareti için küçük yerel kod gerekir.
findings.finding: Two gaps behind a correct sentence. (1) expo-location on Android depends only on Google Play services (FusedLocationProviderClient, no fallback), so phones without Google services, which line 78 accepts, get no location. (2) The iPhone flag lives on CLLocation.sourceInformation, which expo-location never returns, so the 'small native code' must fetch the location itself with CLLocationManager; expo-location is then redundant on iOS. One single-shot read in the own module on both platforms (Android framework LocationManager, iOS CLLocationManager) returns coordinates plus all flags and drops expo-location and play-services-location.

evidence.quote: api 'com.google.android.gms:play-services-location:21.0.1'
mLocationProvider = LocationServices.getFusedLocationProviderClient(mContext)
Core Location sets isSimulatedBySoftware to true if the system generated the location using on-device software simulation.

findings.recommendation_tr: GPS kontrolü açıldığında tek seferlik konumu kendi yerel modülümde okurum: Android'de sistemin konum servisi, iPhone'da CLLocationManager. Sonuçla birlikte Android'in sahte konum işareti ve iPhone'un simülasyon ve aksesuar işaretleri gelir. expo-location plandan çıkar; Google servisi olmayan telefonlarda da konum okunur.

GPS adds a second permission prompt, approximate-location handling, iOS full-accuracy request, flag code and server distance and impossible-travel logic, yet indoors it drifts tens of meters, approximate grants make it useless and iOS spoofers are not flagged. Bluetooth already answers 'is the phone near the instructor' better, and QR stays the main proof.

evidence.quote: GPS-enabled smartphones are typically accurate to within a 4.9 m (16 ft.) radius under open sky.

findings.finding: iOS also flags locations that come from an external accessory (MFi GPS dongle, CarPlay), which is a known hardware spoofing route. It sits in the same sourceInformation object, so recording it costs nothing extra.

evidence.quote: Core Location sets isProducedByAccessory to true if the system retrieved the location from an external accessory attached to the device, such as a Made for iPhone GPS dongle or CarPlay.

findings.plan_quote: En büyük amfide en arka sıradan okunur.
findings.finding: Not measurable as written: no phone class, success rate or time limit, and reading depends on camera pixels per QR module (ML Kit needs at least 2 pixels per module). The hall's screen height and back-row distance are also unknown (open point at line 863).

evidence.quote: In general, the smallest meaningful unit of the barcode should be at least 2 pixels wide, and for 2-dimensional codes, 2 pixels tall.
For typical applications, it's recommended to provide a higher resolution image, such as 1280x720 or 1920x1080, which makes barcodes scannable from a larger distance away from the camera.

findings.recommendation_tr: Hedefi ölçülebilir yazarım: En büyük amfinin en arka sırasında, desteklenen en ucuz Android ve en eski iPhone ile, her telefonda 20 denemenin en az %95'inde QR değişmeden (5 saniye içinde) okunur. Denemeden önce perdenin yüksekliğini ve en arka sıranın uzaklığını not ederim.

findings.plan_quote: Hoca telefonundan o ders için kısa süreli bir eşleştirme kodu açar
findings.finding: Only 'short-lived' is stated. If the pairing code can be redeemed more than once, anyone who learns it can open the projection page at home and get every live QR with zero delay for the whole lesson, which defeats the 10 s forwarding check and Aşama 2 itself. Standard practice for short pairing and authorization codes: short life, single use, deny and revoke on reuse, rate-limit attempts.

evidence.quote: If an authorization code is used more than once, the authorization server MUST deny the request and SHOULD revoke (when possible) all tokens previously issued based on that authorization code.
The user code SHOULD have enough entropy that, when combined with rate-limiting and other mitigations, a brute-force attack becomes infeasible.

findings.recommendation_tr: Eşleştirme kodu tek kullanımlık olur ve ilk açan tarayıcıya bağlanır; bir derste aynı anda tek projeksiyon açık kalır. Kod ikinci kez kullanılırsa reddedilir, açık projeksiyon kapanır ve hocaya bildirilir. Kod denemeleri sunucuda sınırlanır.

findings.plan_quote: Kürsüde internet yoksa hocanın telefonu QR'ı internetsiz üretir.
findings.finding: No QR generator is named although the phone (offline QR, and the receipt QR of Aşama 1) and the panel both need one. react-native-qrcode-svg drags in react-native-svg, a native package. A single pure-JS encoder such as qrcode (lets the caller fix version and error level and returns the module matrix, digits go in numeric mode) can serve both the phone and the panel.

QRCode.create(text, [options]) ... modules, version, errorCorrectionLevel, maskPattern, segments

findings.plan_quote: hoca uygulaması yoklama boyunca açık, ekranı açık kalır
findings.finding: Keeping screens on needs no new dependency: expo-keep-awake already ships inside expo 57 (dependency ~57.0.2), and the projection page can use the browser Screen Wake Lock API (Baseline since March 2025, HTTPS only) so the lectern PC does not dim or lock during the QR window.

evidence.quote: A React component that prevents the screen from sleeping when rendered.
The Screen Wake Lock API provides a way to prevent devices from dimming or locking the screen when an application needs to keep running.

findings.recommendation_tr: Ekran açık kalsın diye yeni paket eklemem: telefonda Expo'nun içinde zaten gelen expo-keep-awake, projeksiyon sayfasında tarayıcının ekranı uyanık tutma özelliği (Screen Wake Lock) kullanılır. Tarayıcıda bu özellik yoksa sayfa hocaya ekran uyku ayarını hatırlatır.

compactness_notes: Net effect if the slice's recommendations are accepted: remove react-native-ble-manager, munim-bluetooth (and its react-native-nitro-modules peer), expo-location (and play-services-location); avoid react-native-qrcode-svg/react-native-svg and VisionCamera 5 (4 packages, ML Kit on iOS too). Tools added: none (pnpm patch is built into pnpm and only used if the back-row test shows slow Android reads; expo-keep-awake already ships inside expo 57; Screen Wake Lock is a browser API). The single own native module grows to hold: BLE advertise plus scan-only (no connect), single-shot location with Android mock flag, iOS simulation and accessory flags and iOS temporary full accuracy, and reading the camera max zoom after start. One key scheme serves QR and the Bluetooth code. Optional deferral inside Aşama 3: GPS until Bluetooth data shows a need. Keep expo-camera: ships with the SDK, maintained each release, 9.6M downloads last month vs 2.4M for VisionCamera; ble-plx correctly rejected. Target at line 845 is already measurable from the QR time slots stored in records, no extra telemetry needed.
open_questions: Line 259: does '2-3 dakikalık pencere' mean the instructor's broadcast window or each student phone's scan duration? S10-F08 assumes the latter is what needs shortening.

Real ImageAnalysis resolution and per-frame ML Kit latency of expo-camera 57 on the cheapest supported Android are unknown: CameraX chooses per device hardware level with Preview and ImageCapture also bound. Needs the back-row device test.
ML Kit says the bundled model adds about 2.4 MB but does not say per ABI; an APK carrying arm64-v8a and armeabi-v7a may grow more. Measure on the first APK build.
Largest hall: screen height and back-row distance are needed to set the QR target (ties to plan line 863).
expo-location on phones without Google services: source shows FusedLocationProviderClient only with no fallback; not field-tested here.
expo-camera 58 (npm 'next' tag, SDK 58) switches selectedLens to deviceType identifiers; harmless while the plan keeps the default lens, relevant if a lens is ever pinned.
